topic.name: 扩散与微观状态
topic.title: 混匀的颜料为什么不会自行聚回一滴？
topic.question: 混匀的颜料为什么不会自行聚回一滴？
topic.description: 从水中颜料的持续随机运动，到四个气体粒子的16种分布，区分微观运动与宏观不可逆性。

sources.title: OpenStax — Entropy on a microscopic scale

translations.混匀的颜料为什么不会自行聚回一滴？: Why does mixed dye not gather back into one drop?
translations.从水中颜料的持续随机运动，到四个气体粒子的16种分布，区分微观运动与宏观不可逆性: Connect dye’s continuing random motion with sixteen arrangements of four gas particles, separating microscopic motion from macroscopic irreversibility.
translations.均匀状态拥有更多可能: Many more ways to be spread out
translations.染料扩散、气体自由扩散与全部十六种左右分布: Dye diffusion, gas free expansion and all sixteen left/right arrangements
translations.染料用放大的示踪点和反射随机游走表现纯扩散，时间加速，不模拟实际水中的对流、溶解: Magnified tracers and reflected random walks represent diffusion with accelerated time, omitting convection, dissolution rates and molecular scale. The four-particle diagrams enumerate side assignments, not full position and momentum states. For equal volumes and independent particles at equilibrium, the sixteen assignments are equally probable. A macroscopic return is extremely unlikely rather than mathematically impossible.
translations.颜料起初集中，个体运动没有统一方向。: Dye starts concentrated; individual motion has no common direction.
translations.粒子持续运动，统计分布逐渐均匀。: Particles keep moving while their statistical distribution becomes more uniform.
translations.四个有颜色编号的粒子都在A内，B为空。: Four identified particles occupy A while B is empty.
translations.粒子进入更大的空间，能量无需凭空增加。: Particles gain access to more space without an extra energy input.
translations.每个粒子可在A或B，共有2的4次方种归属。: Each particle may be in A or B, giving two to the fourth assignments.
translations.全部回到A的概率是2的负N次方，随粒子数迅速下降。: The probability that all return to A is two to the minus N.

cues.title: 在清水中滴入颜料
cues.caption: 颜料起初集中，个体运动没有统一方向。
cues.captionEn: Dye starts concentrated; individual motion has no common direction.
cues.zh: 一滴红色颜料进入水中，起初只占很小一块区域。放大的示踪点各自作随机运动，圈出的粒子也不会知道哪里更稀。这里加速显示纯扩散，实际水中的对流另当别论。
cues.en: A drop of dye initially occupies a small region. Each magnified tracer moves randomly; the highlighted particle does not know where concentration is lower. This accelerated model isolates diffusion, leaving real-water convection aside.

cues.title: 均匀并不意味着静止
cues.caption: 粒子持续运动，统计分布逐渐均匀。
cues.captionEn: Particles keep moving while their statistical distribution becomes more uniform.
cues.zh: 有颜色的粒子逐渐进入原来清澈的区域。浓处有更多粒子可向外运动，因此整体看起来从浓处扩散到稀处。即使颜色已经较均匀，粒子仍不停运动；把画面停住只是暂停观察。
cues.en: Dye spreads into regions that were initially clear. More particles can leave a concentrated region, producing net spreading without directed individual motion. Even when concentration is roughly uniform, particles keep moving; pausing the display only pauses our observation.

cues.title: 先用隔板限制气体
cues.caption: 四个有颜色编号的粒子都在A内，B为空。
cues.captionEn: Four identified particles occupy A while B is empty.
cues.zh: 换成教材的隔板思想实验。四个颜色不同的粒子都在A室，B室空着。粒子碰壁反弹，隔板限制了它们能到达的空间。颜色用于跟踪身份，不表示四种不同气体。
cues.en: Now consider the textbook’s partition thought experiment. Four identifiable particles occupy chamber A; chamber B is empty. Reflecting walls, including the partition, restrict their accessible space. Colours identify particles rather than different gases.

cues.title: 撤去隔板后进入另一半
cues.caption: 粒子进入更大的空间，能量无需凭空增加。
cues.captionEn: Particles gain access to more space without an extra energy input.
cues.zh: 撤去隔板后，原来的粒子延续运动，进入B室。图中没有加热，也没有向外推动活塞。四个粒子仍会出现数量起伏；不要用这一瞬间的左右数量判断大量气体的平衡分布。
cues.en: After removing the partition, the same particles continue into B. No heater or moving piston supplies extra energy here. Four particles show large number fluctuations; a single instantaneous count is not the equilibrium behaviour of a macroscopic gas.

cues.title: 逐一列出十六种归属
cues.caption: 每个粒子可在A或B，共有2的4次方种归属。
cues.captionEn: Each particle may be in A or B, giving two to the fourth assignments.
cues.zh: 把每个粒子只记作在A或在B，四个粒子就有十六种归属。每张小图上排是A，下排是B，同一种颜色始终代表同一粒子。逐张计数，会发现两边各两个粒子有六种归属。
cues.en: Record only whether each particle is in A or B. Four particles give sixteen assignments. In every small diagram, the upper row is A and the lower row is B; colours preserve particle identity. Count the diagrams with two particles in each half: there are six.

cues.title: 少量起伏与宏观概率
cues.caption: 全部回到A的概率是2的负N次方，随粒子数迅速下降。
cues.captionEn: The probability that all return to A is two to the minus N.
cues.zh: 在平衡、等体积、独立粒子的假设下，十六种归属等可能。四个全在A的概率是十六分之一，不能说绝不发生。增加粒子数后，全部回到A的概率按二的负N次方下降。极小的概率解释宏观复原为何难以观察。
cues.en: For equal-volume halves and independent particles at equilibrium, the sixteen assignments are equally likely. All four in A has probability one sixteenth, so it is not forbidden. As particle count grows, all-in-A probability falls as two to the minus N, making macroscopic returns unobservable in practice.
